notes: Autoregressive policy over OAT tokens (ordered action tokenization, H_a=32, 8 register tokens, FSQ [8,5,5,5], pow2 nested dropout, causal register attention). The tokenizer is pre-trained (60k steps), frozen, and decoded with all 8 tokens. Batch size is per GPU; the reference trains 4 x 256. Identical to the quest preset except for the tokenizer.
